On the other hand, what happens when the one person gets it wrong? Presidents have Congress, which can overturn a veto. CEOs have to put significant matters before their shareholders for a vote and are beholden to them in other ways. So all of these other singular positions of power- these "the buck stops here" positions, all of them, have some sort of check on their powers in case they have a significant error in judgement.
